result.title: VampPrior Unleashed
result.summary: Deep latent variable models (DLVMs) underpin many modern analysis pipelines, for example in single-cell genomics, yet their prior distributions have received markedly little attention. The VampPrior approximates the optimal prior (the aggregate posterior) and often attains high model evidence. Here, we identify two key limitations of the VampPrior: it ties prior and posterior uncertainty to a single amortized covariance and clusters poorly due to its fixed uniform mixture weights. We unleash the VampPrior by decoupling its prior and posterior covariances, resolving the conflict of generating high prior and low posterior entropy with the same shared parameters and substantially improving model evidence. We then replace the uniform mixture with a Dirichlet process. When combined, our proposals provide higher model evidence than the VampPrior and robust non-parametric clustering. Augmenting single cell Variational Inference (scVI) with our prior improves single-cell integration and clustering across six atlases while significantly raising model evidence. Our approach changes only the prior and thus can be applied to any DLVM with a continuous latent space.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出 VampPrior 的两点局限——先验与后验不确定性绑定在同一 amortized 协方差、固定均匀混合权重导致聚类差——提出解耦先验与后验协方差、以 Dirichlet process 替换均匀混合，并在单细胞 scVI 上验证模型证据与聚类改善。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其在连续 latent 空间中对混合先验、协方差解耦与非参数聚类的处理，可能为 latent 推理状态的分布建模、状态分组与表示几何提供可供核查的线索。
